question: How does your custom quoting process work?
answer: We evaluate every project individually based on your required deliverables, scope depth, timeline, and asset formats. After reviewing your inquiry or chatting on WhatsApp, we provide a transparent, itemized proposal tailored specifically to your needs—with no rigid package markups.

question: What is the typical turnaround time for a brand identity or website?
answer: Brand identity projects typically take 2 to 3 weeks from discovery to final delivery of master vector packages. Simple 1-to-3 page websites usually take 1 to 2 weeks including mobile responsiveness testing and WhatsApp integration.

question: What file formats will I receive upon project completion?
answer: For brand and graphic design deliverables, you will receive all production-ready master vector files (SVG, EPS, PDF) along with high-resolution web formats (PNG, WebP, JPG) with contrast variations and comprehensive guidelines.

question: How do we communicate throughout the creative project?
answer: We maintain direct, responsive communication via WhatsApp and email. You will collaborate directly with our creative team at each milestone without bureaucratic agency layers.
